rationale: In `registrarBoleto`, `time.Now()` is used to set `objBoleto.DataVencimento` (L87-L88), and `rand.Intn()` generates `objBoleto.CodigoBarra` (L86). Both values are written to the ledger via `PutState` (L107). Since `time.Now()` and unseeded `rand` produce different results across peers, this causes endorsement divergence. The `rand` usage is also nondeterministic but C1 (TIME_NOW) is the primary class per taxonomy ordering.
